claim: G=<a,b,c,t | tat^-1=a, tbt^-1=ab, tct^-1=bcb> admits a proper and cocompact cubical isometric action on a CAT(0) cube complex.
priority_test: An earlier primary theorem, explicit example, or fully justified transfer implying this exact claim defeats historical novelty of the existence conclusion, whether or not it names G.
assumptions: Exact positive final b in bcb; exact ab image of b.
Accepted construction and verification are not re-proved in this priority family.
No assumption that workshop aba variant is isomorphic or commensurable.
No assumption that free action, proper action, CAT(0) metric action, HHG, quasi-isometry or virtually special embedding implies the desired cocompact cubical action.
success_criteria: Inspect current primary theorem statements and relevant hypotheses; identify version dates.
Either present complete applicability proof for prior resolution or bounded reproducible search with precise rejected candidates and gaps.
Finite-index results require a genuine finite-extension cubulation argument, not an assumed implication.
search_families: General free-by-cyclic cubulation and polynomial/UPG mapping tori.
Tubular/iterated HNN combination and standard examples; exact automorphism equivalence.
CAT(0), virtual specialness, finite index, relative cubulation, and coarse geometry implications.
Current polynomial free-by-cyclic HHG/fast-slow work and citations.
Cubical folding and double-coset/hyperplane separation constructions.
boundary_cases: Subgroup or finite-index subgroup without cubical induction.
Unsupported theorem hypothesis reduces to the original cubulation problem.
